Probe the FWA primitives' artifacts and record what is current now

Source: R/lnk_artifact.R
lnk_artifact_probe.Rd

HEADs the object-store artifact behind each FWA primitive in this database and records the answer with recorded_by = "probe" (link#265). This is the weaker kind of record: it says which version is current now, not which one was loaded. It exists because fwapg's load.sh records nothing, and a version that is not written down before the store moves on can never be named (link#270 is the loader-side record). A probe never overwrites a loader row. A probe row is not a baseline: anything that compares a recorded ETag against the store to decide whether a source changed (link#273) must read loader rows only, because a probe's ETag is by construction whatever the store held when the probe ran.

Usage

lnk_artifact_probe(conn, tables = NULL, host = .lnk_host(), max_fail = 5L)

Arguments

conn

A DBI::DBIConnection to the database the primitives live in.

tables

Primitives to probe. Defaults to every FWA primitive (those loaded by fwapg).

host

Host label; see lnk_artifact_record().

max_fail

Stop sending HEADs after this many consecutive failures (no response at all); the rest are recorded with no identity and a note.

Value

Invisibly, the probed rows, with the HTTP status of each HEAD.

Details

The stream network is one object per watershed group. The groups probed are the ones loaded in this database, not a copy of load.sh's discovery query, so the probe cannot drift from what is actually here. The derived fwa_stream_networks_order_parent gets a derived row with no identity, which is correct and permanent.

See also

Other provenance: lnk_artifact_read(), lnk_artifact_record()

Examples

# The FWA artifacts a probe would HEAD for two watershed groups:
prims <- link:::.lnk_input_primitives()
fwa <- prims[startsWith(prims$source, "fwapg/"), ]
link:::.lnk_artifact_expand(fwa, wsg = c("BULK", "MORR"))[, c("kind", "url")]
#>      kind
#> 1  object
#> 2  object
#> 3  object
#> 4  object
#> 5 derived
#> 6  object
#> 7  object
#> 8  object
#> 9  object
#>                                                                                       url
#> 1      https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_stream_networks_sp/BULK.parquet
#> 2      https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_stream_networks_sp/MORR.parquet
#> 3 https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_stream_networks_channel_width.csv.gz
#> 4     https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_stream_networks_discharge.csv.gz
#> 5                                         fwapg/load/fwa_stream_networks_order_parent.sql
#> 6                   https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_lakes_poly.parquet
#> 7                https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_wetlands_poly.parquet
#> 8                  https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_rivers_poly.parquet
#> 9              https://nrs.objectstore.gov.bc.ca/bchamp/fwapg/fwa_obstructions_sp.parquet

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- lnk_db_conn(dbname = "fwapg", host = "localhost", port = 5432L,
                    user = "postgres", password = "postgres")
lnk_artifact_probe(conn)
} # }
